## Window layout and startup

The main window places workspaces and panes between the sidebars. Heidrun Code remembers supported window state and option selections when it starts again.

## Read the status bar

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/status_bar.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/status_bar_git.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/status_bar.md -->

The status bar summarizes workspace and Git information. Select its Git branch section to inspect available branch actions and synchronization information.
